question: A circle is circumscribed on a quadrilateral ABCD. If ∠DAB = 100°, ∠ADB = 35° and ∠CDB = 40°, then find the measure of ∠DBC.
solution:
Given:

A circle is circumscribed on a quadrilateral ABCD.

∠DAB = 100°, ∠ADB = 35° and ∠CDB = 40°

Concept used:

In the case of a cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of opposite angles of the quadrilateral is 180°.

The sum of all internal angles of a triangle is 180°.

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23d2eba79703e79e0f70cf9a71ae702e9d874808b714e9a1764997230e6470ed.png] 

Considering ΔDAB, 

∠DAB + ∠ADB + ∠DBA = 180°

⇒ 100° + 35° + ∠DBA = 180°

⇒ ∠DBA = 180° - 135° 

⇒ ∠DBA = 45°

⇒ ∠ABD = 45°

Since the circle is circumscribed on a quadrilateral ABCD, ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral.

So, ∠ADC + ∠ABC = 180°

⇒ (∠ADB + ∠CDB) + (∠ABD + ∠DBC) = 180°

⇒ 35° + 40° + 45° + ∠DBC = 180°

⇒ ∠DBC = 180° - 120° 

⇒ ∠DBC = 60°

**∴ The measure of ∠DBC is 60°.**
